Domain: Mental — Resource: Focus — Specialty: Contingency — Specialty Condition: Exposed

Preparation, deception, tactical exploitation, improvisation, traps, and technical skill — turning an opponent's own choices into part of the plan.

Contingency

A Cunning Action's Rider may establish a Contingency (a Trigger and an effect that resolves when it occurs). Establish only one per Round. A Contingency's resolution is not a newly declared Reaction. Unused Contingencies expire at the start of your next Turn.

Expertises

  • Deception
  • Infiltration
  • Sabotage
  • Exploitation
  • Observation
  • Improvisation
  • Sleight

Subtypes

  • Ambush
  • Trap
  • Reversal
  • Gambit
  • Evasion
